description:
Lists the files (name, size, received) a Client sent through their link for a Quarter — or for every Client in a Quarter — with download links valid 24 hours for the signed-in practitioner, and the Client's note marked as written by the Client.
Use this when: asked what a Client sent or to download it.

client.description: Client name, email or your own reference

quarter.description: Quarter like "2026-27 Q3". Default: the Quarter whose HMRC deadline is next.
